intro x y hx hy h
have hxy : (x - 1) * (y - 1) ≥ 0 :=
  calc
    (x - 1) * (y - 1) = x * y - x - y + 1 by ring
    _ = x * y - 2 + 1 by rw h
    _ = x * y - 1 by simp
  end
apply sq_le.2
use 1
apply and.intro
· have h1 : x * y ≤ 1 := by apply sq_le.1; use 1; exact (le_refl 1)
   exact h1
· have h2 : -1 ≤ x * y := by
   have h3 : x ≤ 2 := by rw h; apply le_add_right
   have h4 : y ≤ 2 := by rw h; apply le_add_right
   have h5 : x * y ≤ 4 := by apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4; exact (le_refl 2)
   have h6 : -1 ≤ x * y := by
     have h7 : -1 ≤ x := by apply le_trans (le_zero_right x) (le_refl 0)
     have h8 : -1 ≤ y := by apply le_trans (le_zero_right y) (le_refl 0)
     exact (mul_nonneg (le_trans h7 (le_refl 0)) (le_trans h8 (le_refl 0)))
   exact h6
   exact h2
